CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session uuid, p_step text, p_authority uuid, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone, p_facts jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r public.mission_run_state%rowtype;b mission_generic_owner.run_bindings%rowtype;m public.master_v2_sessions%rowtype;
 sc jsonb;a jsonb;pin jsonb;nv public.nb_template_versions%rowtype;nt public.nb_templates%rowtype;
 actors jsonb:='[]';sources jsonb:='[]';ctx jsonb;loc text;from_at timestamptz;persona text;previous_fato jsonb;director jsonb;setting_body text;knowledge_context jsonb:='[]';step_entry text;brief_entry text;continuity_snapshot jsonb;prior_progression jsonb;
begin
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then return mission_factory_owner.quest_context_v1(p_session,p_step,p_authority,p_cutoff,p_facts);end if;

 if not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) then return mission_generic_owner.flow_previous_narrative_context(p_session,p_step,p_authority,p_cutoff,p_facts);end if; select * into strict m from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session;
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=p_session;
 select * into strict b from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings where master_session_id=p_session;
 sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,p_step);
 director:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(p_session,p_step);
 if director is not null and r.plan_id='910c5217-cf49-49dd-a50c-24ee018ad776'::uuid and p_step='assalto_simulato' then
  director:=director||jsonb_build_object(
   'plot_private','Il riparo corretto è la gola rocciosa con una grotta poco profonda. Tetsuna e, con due partecipanti, Nami sono istruttori mascherati: la loro identità resta segreta. Il contatto non impone lo scontro. Osservano scelte, richieste e prudenza; possono provocare una escalation motivata nella scena. Se la tensione si scioglie senza combattimento, accompagnano i partecipanti alla valutazione. Se Combat si apre, il server tutela i PG prima del KO. La prova termina come valutazione formativa, mai come sconfitta reale.',
   'actors',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(da||jsonb_build_object(
     'goal_private','Valutare adattabilità e prudenza durante il contatto; non imporre lo scontro se le azioni e la situazione consentono un esito narrativo.',
     'known_facts_private','È un istruttore mascherato di Suna, Deshi meccanico senza tecniche. Mantiene segreta la propria identità. Può simulare un assalto soltanto dopo una escalation osservabile; non dichiarare esiti meccanici, danni o reazioni dei PG. Se la tensione si scioglie senza scontro, accompagna i partecipanti alla valutazione.') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(director->'actors') with ordinality d(da,ord)),
   'director_notes','Introduci figure ammantate percepibili. Lascia aperti osservazione, richieste, trattativa e uscita senza Combat; uno scontro richiede escalation concreta e nuovo Fato prima del pannello.',
   'entry_public','Tra le rocce che offrono riparo compaiono figure ammantate; i loro volti e le loro intenzioni restano incerti.',
   'consequences',case when exists (
     select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(director->'consequences','[]'::jsonb)) dc
     where dc->>'transition_key'='academy_no_combat_to_evaluation')
    then coalesce(director->'consequences','[]'::jsonb)
    else coalesce(director->'consequences','[]'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
     'transition_key','academy_no_combat_to_evaluation',
     'public_fact','La tensione si scioglie senza combattimento e la prova passa alla valutazione.',
     'private_note','Non dichiarare una vittoria o sconfitta meccanica.')) end);
 end if;
 step_entry:=director->>'entry_public';
 step_entry:=director->>'entry_public';
 -- Project the sealed director document onto the actual roster. The source snapshot is unchanged.
 if director is not null and exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
  where ar.mission_id=r.mission_id and ar.active
   and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants mp
    where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.left_at is null and mp.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster) then
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.policies pol
   where pol.mission_id=r.mission_id and pol.policy_key in ('suna_prova_tempesta','suna_prova_tempesta:staff:'||r.mission_id::text) and pol.active)
  then raise exception 'MC_ROSTER_EDITORIAL_PROJECTION_UNDEFINED';end if;
  director:=director||jsonb_build_object(
   'actors',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(da order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
    from jsonb_array_elements(director->'actors') with ordinality d(da,ord)
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=r.mission_id and ar.actor_key=da->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants mp
       where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.left_at is null and mp.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
   'plot_private',director->>'plot_private',
   'director_notes',director->>'director_notes',
   'entry_public',director->>'entry_public',
   'consequences',coalesce(director->'consequences','[]'::jsonb));
 end if;
 if director is not null and p_step in ('briefing','ricerca_riparo') and exists(
   select 1 from mission_academy_owner.policies pol
   where pol.mission_id=r.mission_id
     and pol.policy_key in ('suna_prova_tempesta','suna_prova_tempesta:staff:'||r.mission_id::text)
     and pol.active) then
  brief_entry:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(p_session,'briefing')->>'entry_public';
  if nullif(btrim(brief_entry),'') is null or nullif(btrim(step_entry),'') is null
  then raise exception 'MC_SUNA_PUBLIC_ENTRY_MISSING';end if;
  director:=director||jsonb_build_object(
    'entry_public',step_entry,
    'setting',jsonb_build_object(
      'name','Deserto di Suna',
      'description',case when p_step='briefing' then brief_entry
        else 'Il deserto alterna dune basse, tratti di terreno duro e rocce affioranti. Raffiche irregolari sollevano sabbia.' end));
 end if;
 if director is null then
  select name into strict loc from public.locations where id=m.location_id;
 else
  loc:=case when nullif(btrim(director#>>'{setting,name}'),'') is not null then director#>>'{setting,name}' else 'Ambientazione della missione' end;
  setting_body:=director#>>'{setting,description}';
  if director->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'mission-director-context/1'
   or nullif(btrim(loc),'') is null or nullif(btrim(setting_body),'') is null
  then raise exception 'MC_DIRECTOR_CONTEXT_INVALID';end if;
 end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.character_id::text,'name',c.name,'kind','PG','rank',c.rank,'persona',null,'may_speak',false) order by p.joined_at,p.character_id),'[]')
 into actors from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null;
 for a in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') loop
  -- Match the locked-roster rule used by the authoritative combat opener.
  if exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
   where ar.mission_id=r.mission_id and ar.actor_key=a->>'actor_key' and ar.active
    and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants mp
     where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.left_at is null and mp.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
  then continue;end if;
  if p_facts->>'entry_preview' is distinct from 'private'
    and not mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(p_session,p_step,a->>'actor_key',
      nullif(p_facts->>'entry_batch_id','')::uuid)
  then continue;end if;
  if a->>'mechanical_binding_id' is not null then
   select x into strict pin from jsonb_array_elements(b.snapshot->'binding_pins') x where x->>'mechanical_binding_id'=a->>'mechanical_binding_id';
  else
   select x into strict pin from jsonb_array_elements(b.snapshot->'narrative_pins') x where x->>'narrative_version_id'=a->>'narrative_version_id';
  end if;
  select * into strict nv from public.nb_template_versions where id=(pin->>'narrative_version_id')::uuid
   and control_version=(pin->>'narrative_version_control_version')::bigint and content_sha256=pin->>'narrative_content_sha256' and review_state='approved';
  select * into strict nt from public.nb_templates where id=nv.template_id
   and control_version=(pin->>'narrative_template_control_version')::bigint and lifecycle_state='approved';
  -- Approved private persona; Staff receives conduct and forbidden without raw skeleton or mechanics.
  persona:=(jsonb_build_object('nome',nt.display_name,'voce',nv.skeleton->'voice','gesti',nv.skeleton->'gestures',
   'life_core',jsonb_build_object(
    'background',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('role',nv.skeleton#>'{identity,role}','origin',nv.skeleton#>'{identity,origin}')),
    'motivations',nv.skeleton->'motivations','goals',nv.skeleton->'goals','fears',nv.skeleton->'fears',
    'fragility',nv.skeleton->'fragility','resilience',nv.skeleton->'resilience',
    'character_errors',nv.skeleton->'character_errors','recovery',nv.skeleton->'recovery',
    'relationships',nv.skeleton->'relationships',
    'continuity',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('emotional',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,emotional}',
      'relational',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,relational}','emotional_endings',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,emotional_endings}')))) || case when (mission_academy_owner.staff_carrier_runtime(p_session) OR mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session)) then jsonb_build_object('conduct',nv.skeleton->'conduct','forbidden',nv.skeleton->'forbidden') else '{}'::jsonb end)::text;
  if director is not null then
   knowledge_context:=knowledge_context||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('actor_id','png:'||(a->>'actor_key'),
    'actor_key',a->>'actor_key','knowledge_limits',nv.skeleton->'knowledge_limits','knowledge_boundary',nv.knowledge_boundary));
  end if;
  actors:=actors||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id','png:'||(a->>'actor_key'),'name',nt.display_name,'kind','PNG','rank',null,'persona',persona,'may_speak',coalesce(a#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}' ? 'speak',true)));
 end loop;
 if director is null then
  select coalesce(max(x.finalized_at),m.created_at) into from_at from mission_generic_owner.work_items x
   where x.master_session_id=p_session and x.kind='narration' and x.state='completed';
 else
  -- Only mission-role acquisition advances this continuous chat cursor.
  -- Combat's declaration checkpoint covers a subset, not every chat message.
  select coalesce(max((x.payload#>>'{context,source_cursor,through}')::timestamptz),m.created_at)
   into from_at from mission_generic_owner.work_items x
   where x.master_session_id=p_session and x.kind='narration' and x.state='completed'
    and x.payload->>'mode'='mission' and x.payload#>>'{context,schema_version}'='mission-narrative-context/2'
    and x.payload#>>'{context,source_cursor,scope}'='mission_roles';
  if p_cutoff<from_at then raise exception 'MC_SOURCE_CURSOR_REVERSED';end if;
 end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',msg.id::text,'master_session_id',p_session,'kind','role','actor_id',msg.character_id::text,
  'sequence',q.seq,'body',msg.body,'sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'visibility','public','complete',true) order by q.seq),'[]') into sources
 from (select z.id,row_number() over(order by
    case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
      where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
      (select rs.submission_order from mission_generic_owner.role_submissions rs
       join mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors rc
         on rc.master_session_id=rs.master_session_id
        and rc.window_epoch=rs.window_epoch
       where rs.master_session_id=p_session and rs.message_id=z.id)
    end, z.created_at,z.id)::bigint seq from public.messages z
  where z.location_id=m.location_id and z.kind='say' and z.recipient_user is null 
and ((not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
       where c.master_session_id=p_session)
       and z.created_at>from_at and z.created_at<=p_cutoff)
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) latest
       join public.master_v2_participants active_participant
         on active_participant.session_id=p_session
        and active_participant.user_id_snapshot=latest.user_id
        and active_participant.character_id=latest.character_id
        and active_participant.left_at is null
        and active_participant.engagement_state='attivo'
       where latest.message_id=z.id and latest.valid))

  and (director is null or not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items cw,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cw.payload#>'{scene,snapshot,sources}','[]'::jsonb)) cs
   where cw.master_session_id=p_session and cw.kind='narration' and cw.state='completed'
    and cw.payload->>'mode'='combat' and cs->>'kind'='role' and cs->>'id'=z.id::text)
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
    join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.source_window_id=uw.id
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id is not null
    and ub.state='published' and z.id=any(uw.role_ids))
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items uw,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(uw.payload->'resolved_scenes','[]'::jsonb)) rs,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(coalesce(rs->'native_scene',rs)#>'{scene,snapshot,sources}','[]'::jsonb)) us
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.kind='narration' and uw.state='completed'
    and uw.payload->>'mode'='unified' and us->>'kind'='role' and us->>'id'=z.id::text))
  and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.character_id=z.character_id
   and exists(select 1 from public.characters cc where cc.id=z.character_id and cc.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot) and mp.joined_at<=z.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>z.created_at))) q
 join public.messages msg on msg.id=q.id;
 -- Published history is validated and compressed privately; no prose is copied
 -- into the current work except Fati after the last verified memory and the latest Fato.
 continuity_snapshot:=mission_generic_owner.continuity_snapshot(p_session);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',x.value->>'id','master_session_id',p_session,'kind','fato','actor_id',null,
  'sequence',(x.value->>'sequence')::bigint,'body',x.value->>'body','sha256',x.value->>'sha256',
  'visibility','public','complete',true) order by (x.value->>'sequence')::bigint),'[]'::jsonb)
 into previous_fato from jsonb_array_elements(continuity_snapshot->'delta') x;
 select jsonb_build_object('work_id',dw.id,'step_key',dw.step_key,
   'action_kind',dw.result#>>'{decision,action_kind}',
   'progression',dw.result->'progression_audit')
 into prior_progression
 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
 join mission_generic_owner.work_items dw on dw.id=ub.decision_work_id
 where ub.master_session_id=p_session and ub.state='published'
   and ub.step_key=p_step and dw.state='completed'
   and dw.result->'progression_audit' is not null
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id=ub.message_id
      and uw.superseded_at is not null)
 order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
 sources:=previous_fato||sources;
 ctx:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-narrative-context/1','master_session_id',p_session,'step_key',p_step,
  'run_control_version',r.control_version,'definition_sha256',b.snapshot_sha256,'authority_receipt_id',p_authority,
  'location',loc,'actors',actors,'sources',sources,'resolved_facts',p_facts-'entry_preview'-'entry_batch_id',
  'continuity',continuity_snapshot->'continuity','prior_progression',prior_progression,
  'history_chain_sha256',continuity_snapshot->'history_chain_sha256',
  'history_count',continuity_snapshot->'history_count');
 if director is not null then
  -- Only the explicitly public setting becomes a source. Plot, notes and plans
  -- remain in the separately typed private director envelope.
  sources:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id','mission-setting:'||p_session||':'||p_step,
   'master_session_id',p_session,'kind','setting','actor_id',null,'sequence',0,'body',setting_body,
   'sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(setting_body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
   'visibility','public','complete',true))||sources;
  ctx:=ctx||jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-narrative-context/2','sources',sources,
   'director_context',director,'transition_context',null,'knowledge_context',knowledge_context,
   'source_cursor',jsonb_build_object('scope','mission_roles','through',p_cutoff));
 end if;
 if p_facts->>'entry_preview' is distinct from 'private' then
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_visible_context(ctx,sc,nullif(p_facts->>'entry_batch_id','')::uuid);
 end if;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
   ctx:=ctx||jsonb_build_object('source_revision',
     mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session));
 end if;
 return ctx;
end;
$function$

    from jsonb_array_elements(director->'actors') with ordinality d(da,ord)
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar

  loc:=case when nullif(btrim(director#>>'{setting,name}'),'') is not null then director#>>'{setting,name}' else 'Ambientazione della missione' end;
  setting_body:=director#>>'{setting,description}';
  if director->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'mission-director-context/1'
   or nullif(btrim(loc),'') is null or nullif(btrim(setting_body),'') is null
  then raise exception 'MC_DIRECTOR_CONTEXT_INVALID';end if;
 end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.character_id::text,'name',c.name,'kind','PG','rank',c.rank,'persona',null,'may_speak',false) order by p.joined_at,p.character_id),'[]')
 into actors from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null;
 for a in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') loop
  -- Match the locked-roster rule used by the authoritative combat opener.
  if exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
   where ar.mission_id=r.mission_id and ar.actor_key=a->>'actor_key' and ar.active
    and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants mp
     where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.left_at is null and mp.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
  then continue;end if;
  if p_facts->>'entry_preview' is distinct from 'private'
    and not mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(p_session,p_step,a->>'actor_key',
      nullif(p_facts->>'entry_batch_id','')::uuid)
  then continue;end if;
  if a->>'mechanical_binding_id' is not null then
   select x into strict pin from jsonb_array_elements(b.snapshot->'binding_pins') x where x->>'mechanical_binding_id'=a->>'mechanical_binding_id';
  else
   select x into strict pin from jsonb_array_elements(b.snapshot->'narrative_pins') x where x->>'narrative_version_id'=a->>'narrative_version_id';
  end if;
  select * into strict nv from public.nb_template_versions where id=(pin->>'narrative_version_id')::uuid
   and control_version=(pin->>'narrative_version_control_version')::bigint and content_sha256=pin->>'narrative_content_sha256' and review_state='approved';
  select * into strict nt from public.nb_templates where id=nv.template_id
   and control_version=(pin->>'narrative_template_control_version')::bigint and lifecycle_state='approved';
  -- Approved private persona; Staff receives conduct and forbidden without raw skeleton or mechanics.
  persona:=(jsonb_build_object('nome',nt.display_name,'voce',nv.skeleton->'voice','gesti',nv.skeleton->'gestures',
   'life_core',jsonb_build_object(
    'background',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('role',nv.skeleton#>'{identity,role}','origin',nv.skeleton#>'{identity,origin}')),
    'motivations',nv.skeleton->'motivations','goals',nv.skeleton->'goals','fears',nv.skeleton->'fears',
    'fragility',nv.skeleton->'fragility','resilience',nv.skeleton->'resilience',
    'character_errors',nv.skeleton->'character_errors','recovery',nv.skeleton->'recovery',
    'relationships',nv.skeleton->'relationships',
    'continuity',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('emotional',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,emotional}',
      'relational',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,relational}','emotional_endings',nv.skeleton#>'{continuity,emotional_endings}')))) || case when (mission_academy_owner.staff_carrier_runtime(p_session) OR mission_generic_owner.c726_factory_staff_runtime_v1(p_session)) then jsonb_build_object('conduct',nv.skeleton->'conduct','forbidden',nv.skeleton->'forbidden') else '{}'::jsonb end)::text;
  if director is not null then
   knowledge_context:=knowledge_context||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('actor_id','png:'||(a->>'actor_key'),
    'actor_key',a->>'actor_key','knowledge_limits',nv.skeleton->'knowledge_limits','knowledge_boundary',nv.knowledge_boundary));
  end if;
  actors:=actors||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id','png:'||(a->>'actor_key'),'name',nt.display_name,'kind','PNG','rank',null,'persona',persona,'may_speak',coalesce(a#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}' ? 'speak',true)));
 end loop;
 if director is null then
  select coalesce(max(x.finalized_at),m.created_at) into from_at from mission_generic_owner.work_items x
   where x.master_session_id=p_session and x.kind='narration' and x.state='completed';
 else
  -- Only mission-role acquisition advances this continuous chat cursor.
  -- Combat's declaration checkpoint covers a subset, not every chat message.
  select coalesce(max((x.payload#>>'{context,source_cursor,through}')::timestamptz),m.created_at)
   into from_at from mission_generic_owner.work_items x
   where x.master_session_id=p_session and x.kind='narration' and x.state='completed'
    and x.payload->>'mode'='mission' and x.payload#>>'{context,schema_version}'='mission-narrative-context/2'
    and x.payload#>>'{context,source_cursor,scope}'='mission_roles';
  if p_cutoff<from_at then raise exception 'MC_SOURCE_CURSOR_REVERSED';end if;
 end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',msg.id::text,'master_session_id',p_session,'kind','role','actor_id',msg.character_id::text,
  'sequence',q.seq,'body',msg.body,'sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'visibility','public','complete',true) order by q.seq),'[]') into sources
 from (select z.id,row_number() over(order by
    case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
      where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
      (select rs.submission_order from mission_generic_owner.role_submissions rs
       join mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors rc
         on rc.master_session_id=rs.master_session_id
        and rc.window_epoch=rs.window_epoch
       where rs.master_session_id=p_session and rs.message_id=z.id)
    end, z.created_at,z.id)::bigint seq from public.messages z
  where z.location_id=m.location_id and z.kind='say' and z.recipient_user is null 
and ((not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
       where c.master_session_id=p_session)
       and z.created_at>from_at and z.created_at<=p_cutoff)
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) latest
       join public.master_v2_participants active_participant
         on active_participant.session_id=p_session
        and active_participant.user_id_snapshot=latest.user_id
        and active_participant.character_id=latest.character_id
        and active_participant.left_at is null
        and active_participant.engagement_state='attivo'
       where latest.message_id=z.id and latest.valid))

  and (director is null or not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items cw,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cw.payload#>'{scene,snapshot,sources}','[]'::jsonb)) cs
   where cw.master_session_id=p_session and cw.kind='narration' and cw.state='completed'
    and cw.payload->>'mode'='combat' and cs->>'kind'='role' and cs->>'id'=z.id::text)
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
    join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.source_window_id=uw.id
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id is not null
    and ub.state='published' and z.id=any(uw.role_ids))
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items uw,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(uw.payload->'resolved_scenes','[]'::jsonb)) rs,
    lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(coalesce(rs->'native_scene',rs)#>'{scene,snapshot,sources}','[]'::jsonb)) us
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.kind='narration' and uw.state='completed'
    and uw.payload->>'mode'='unified' and us->>'kind'='role' and us->>'id'=z.id::text))
  and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp where mp.session_id=p_session and mp.character_id=z.character_id
   and exists(select 1 from public.characters cc where cc.id=z.character_id and cc.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot) and mp.joined_at<=z.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>z.created_at))) q
 join public.messages msg on msg.id=q.id;
 -- Published history is validated and compressed privately; no prose is copied
 -- into the current work except Fati after the last verified memory and the latest Fato.
 continuity_snapshot:=mission_generic_owner.continuity_snapshot(p_session);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',x.value->>'id','master_session_id',p_session,'kind','fato','actor_id',null,
  'sequence',(x.value->>'sequence')::bigint,'body',x.value->>'body','sha256',x.value->>'sha256',
  'visibility','public','complete',true) order by (x.value->>'sequence')::bigint),'[]'::jsonb)
 into previous_fato from jsonb_array_elements(continuity_snapshot->'delta') x;
 select jsonb_build_object('work_id',dw.id,'step_key',dw.step_key,
   'action_kind',dw.result#>>'{decision,action_kind}',
   'progression',dw.result->'progression_audit')
 into prior_progression
 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
 join mission_generic_owner.work_items dw on dw.id=ub.decision_work_id
 where ub.master_session_id=p_session and ub.state='published'
   and ub.step_key=p_step and dw.state='completed'
   and dw.result->'progression_audit' is not null
   and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
    where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id=ub.message_id
      and uw.superseded_at is not null)
 order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
 sources:=previous_fato||sources;
 ctx:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-narrative-context/1','master_session_id',p_session,'step_key',p_step,
  'run_control_version',r.control_version,'definition_sha256',b.snapshot_sha256,'authority_receipt_id',p_authority,
  'location',loc,'actors',actors,'sources',sources,'resolved_facts',p_facts-'entry_preview'-'entry_batch_id',
  'continuity',continuity_snapshot->'continuity','prior_progression',prior_progression,
  'history_chain_sha256',continuity_snapshot->'history_chain_sha256',
  'history_count',continuity_snapshot->'history_count');
 if director is not null then
  -- Only the explicitly public setting becomes a source. Plot, notes and plans
  -- remain in the separately typed private director envelope.
  sources:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id','mission-setting:'||p_session||':'||p_step,
   'master_session_id',p_session,'kind','setting','actor_id',null,'sequence',0,'body',setting_body,
   'sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(setting_body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
   'visibility','public','complete',true))||sources;
  ctx:=ctx||jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-narrative-context/2','sources',sources,
   'director_context',director,'transition_context',null,'knowledge_context',knowledge_context,
   'source_cursor',jsonb_build_object('scope','mission_roles','through',p_cutoff));
 end if;
 if p_facts->>'entry_preview' is distinct from 'private' then
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_visible_context(ctx,sc,nullif(p_facts->>'entry_batch_id','')::uuid);
 end if;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
   ctx:=ctx||jsonb_build_object('source_revision',
     mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(p_session));
 end if;
 return ctx;
end;
